claim: Retire a compressed cluster's decoder after every logical blob is successfully materialized, while retaining independent decoded buffers for random and range reads
status: Focused host fail-before/pass-after verification completed; Android release memory benefit not established

integration.scope: Both Android targets; iOS and desktop patch sets unchanged
integration.canonicalStrictDryRun: The exact final canonical patch subsequently passed patch --batch --fuzz=0 --dry-run against the retained pre-retirement source with preceding patches applied; no source application or test repetition was needed.
integration.canonicalGeneration: Final patch generated with the real diff -u binary from retained pre-retirement source and the exercised post-retirement source. Formatting changes do not alter resulting production or test bytes.
integration.strictComposition: Fresh pinned source accepted all preceding patches and retirement with --fuzz=0. A second fresh source accepted the full libzim sequence followed by the optional LP32 raw-blob correction.

behavior: No additional reads or decompression are requested to trigger retirement.
Completion is all logical cluster blobs, not the end of the first compression frame.
Partial or failed final decoding retains the decoder and previously materialized blobs.
Raw readers retain their prior ownership and behavior.
The conservative SIZE_MAX guard excludes LP32 oversized-blob placeholders from completion.
Memory-size queries and reader retirement share the existing cluster mutex; costing is null-safe after retirement.
No archive-handle, source-identity, retained-descriptor, split-file, permission or revocation contracts change.

hostVerification.configuration: Native reader-only core, Xapian disabled, header buffering disabled; compression and decoderstreamreader targets only

before.example: A completed single-blob reader was not destroyed; estimated cost stayed 393244 bytes instead of the retired-reader baseline 131092 bytes.

after.coverage: All six retirement cases plus the prior cluster-cost accounting regression and stream-size accounting regression

boundaries: The global nominal cluster-cache budget remains 16777216 bytes; no capacity reduction was made.
Cached costs remain one-time estimates with the existing half-decoded-data contribution and decoder-size clamp; this is not a hard resident-memory ceiling.

The original first dry-run rejected a costing-hunk context boundary. It was corrected before application; the proof resumed only the failed non-mutating step, preserving successful setup and original failure identities.
The cache-publication concurrency regression uses an explicit cost gate and a 25 ms observation; it is not exhaustive race or ThreadSanitizer certification.
LP32 patch composition was verified, not ARMv7 runtime execution.
No phone memory saving or completed Android SDK/release verification is asserted by these host results.
